# netbox_circuit_group (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/circuits/circuitgroup/):

> Circuit groups can be used to organize circuits into administrative groups, for instance to indicate that multiple circuits form a redundant pair or are otherwise related.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_tenant" "tenanta" {
    name = "TenantA"
}

resource "netbox_circuit_group" "groupa" {
    name      = "GroupA"
    slug      = "groupa"
    tenant_id = netbox_tenant.tenanta.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `comments` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String)
- `description` (String)
- `slug` (String)
- `tags` (Set of String)
- `tenant_id` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags_all` (Set of String)
